next_source_recovery_priorities.reason: New selected compile/provided gaps need immediate source and provenance review: custom JSON library in server/WFS/GeoNode OAuth, Marlin renderer in WAR, MapFish ImageIO/Xerces, XSD PicoContainer, NetCDF OPeNDAP and provided Oracle driver. The retained Oracle, JAI ImageIO and Marlin POMs declare no license or SCM; the custom JSON-lib POM points to generic git://github.com/aalmiray/Json-lib.git without an exact tag, which does not prove 2.4.2-geoserver source correspondence.

Direct compile declarations in referencing/XML and importer, plus H2 shared compile/test reach. Recover exact source release/archive provenance and retain source-to-binary candidate mapping before full selected build.

Direct EPSG-HSQL test dependency; recover exact source and preserve selected testing scope.

Trace likely application-transitive gaps as well as plugin inputs. ANTLR has a retained Hibernate declaration, bigint an Imagen parent declaration, and xmlpull XStream/mxparser declarations. No direct overlap does not imply tooling-only or unused.

For remaining historical Maven/reporting/IDE/SCM/tool dependencies, use retained POM and plugin-log edges to group exact source releases. Keep all gaps open until actual mediation/goal reachability and source correspondence are established. Empty/aggregate jars (listenablefuture/flexmark-all) require explicit content/packaging evidence, not a source-gap waiver.

New gaps without selected direct declarations still need mediation/source recovery: Typica, legacy PostgreSQL JDBC and xml-apis-ext. Retained declaration/plugin-log examples are leads, not permission to mark these unused.
